std_returns = returns.std()

sharpe_ratios = mean_returns / std_returns

num_instruments = len(weights)
additional_weight_per_instrument = remaining_weight / num_instruments

# Add additional weight to each instrument
adjusted_weights = weights + additional_weight_per_instrument

# Ensure the weights sum to exactly 1
adjusted_weights /= adjusted_weights.sum()

# Print the adjusted weights
print(adjusted_weights)
"""

}
